segments.name: Digital asset technology
segments.description: Holds ETH as long-term reserves and provides Ethereum staking and validator infrastructure services to third parties.
segments.evidence: In accordance with ASC 280-10, Segment Reporting, management has determined that the Company operates as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Third parties pay the company fees for staking services through MAVAN, and the company earns staking revenue on its own ETH.
revenueModel.evidence: Our results of operations are driven primarily by changes in the fair value of our ETH holdings, staking revenue from our own ETH and revenue from staking services provided to third parties through MAVAN, the U.S. dollar value of which fluctuates with ETH prices.

changes.text: From July 2025 the company shifted focus from Bitcoin mining and hosting toward Ethereum and ETH staking.
changes.evidence: Beginning in July 2025, we expanded our business to focus primarily on Ethereum and its native cryptocurrency, ETH, transitioning from primarily Bitcoin mining and hosting activities toward long-term accumulation, staking and optimization of our digital asset holdings.
